title: Emergency Childbirth
description: Plain-text reference for assisting an unplanned birth: gathering supplies, positioning the mother, and the crowning, head, and body delivery stages. Covers cord and newborn care, APGAR scoring, a baby who isn't breathing, warning signs for mother and baby, and what not to do.
shortDescription: Delivering a baby when help can't arrive: stages, cord care, and APGAR
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
